claim.summary: Over any characteristic-two field, for m,n>=2 and F_ij=(AB)_ij+delta_ij, no linear functional through degree four both normalizes one, annihilates q F_ij for deg q<=2, and is invariant under every permutation of the inner indices. The two-by-two minor has functional value one from the equations but zero from its even ordered-pair orbits. No Boolean axioms are needed. The added symmetry is impossible even in the satisfiable m=2<=n control, not a degree-four refutation of the rank contradiction.
claim.assessment: Working exact minor and orbit-count control, passed by the sole staged medium reviewer. Symmetry is an added premise; no Boolean axioms or rank-deficiency hypothesis is needed.

significance.next_action: Retain the obstruction when using invariant theory; do not impose symmetric moments on arbitrary valid designs.
